name: tun-module
title: TUN kernel module
description: Loads the Linux `tun` kernel module so the printer has a working /dev/net/tun. Mesh-VPN plugins (ZeroTier needs it; Tailscale runs lighter with it) build a virtual network interface on top of it. The Snapmaker U1's stock kernel ships tun neither built in nor as a module, so this plugin carries a `tun.ko` cross-built against the exact running kernel (6.1.99 aarch64) and insmods it at boot, before the services that need it. Nothing to configure: install it (or install a VPN plugin that requires it) and /dev/net/tun is there.
tagline: Adds /dev/net/tun to the printer, the base a mesh VPN builds on.
